motion.note: Not a confirmed measurement: the source is found in only 110 of 150 images; the brightness changes 3.2-fold between visits, so the image centre can shift without any real motion if the source is an unresolved pair. The star saturates the detector; positions come from the wings of its image.

method: pixel-integrated Gaussian fit on raw cutouts, median per epoch
